name: Docs
description: A public, unauthenticated documentation website at /docs and /docs/{slug}: a left sidebar grouped by category with a client-side search box, a readable content pane rendered through the shared /markdown renderer, an auto-generated on-this-page table of contents per guide, and prev/next navigation through the guide order (by nav_order). Bespoke pages in the app-shell/talk.py style, not the generic view_render block system -- a guide site is a distinct UX shape from record CRUD. The doc_pages records themselves are seeded content, not something visitors write, so every rule is a plain public read/execute grant with no is_public field or row_filter.
